view.summary: In The Mirror: explore a side-scrolling mirror world as Cinderella, defeat Raptures for Gold and Cores, unlock new Glass Slippers abilities through main missions, and replay it on NEW GAME+. Also includes the April Fools Mecha Shifty stage built on the same engine.

overview.title: How it plays
overview.text:
Cinderella explores 8 connected chapters (plus a hidden “???” danger zone) by running, jumping and shooting with her Glass Slippers. Main missions lead from area to area; each one points you to a spot, a boss or an item, and many of them unlock a new ability (Dash, Double Jump, Absorb Mode, Glass Slippers B/C/D, Burst).

Defeated Raptures drop Gold (and, from bosses on NEW GAME+, Cores). Spend them in the Upgrade Shop on six permanent upgrades, and in the General Shop on Modules and Memories. Modules are equipment that tweak a skill; each costs module energy and you can only equip as much as your energy allows.

Hidden around the map are 40 Memories (lore texts) and 16 Keys, which open locked doors. Touching a save point (a petal-shaped glass fragment) saves everything; there is only one save file.

After the ending you can start NEW GAME+: the difficulty rises, exploration, upgrades, modules and items are kept, and the main missions start over (with a repeatable boss-hunt mission and bigger drops).

overview.title: Loading tips
items:
The way to accomplish something you think is impossible
is to overlay the image of the person you despise the most.

Distort it and show them.
Most people take what they see at face value.

Whispering is better than shouting.
In matters of deceit, a composed heart often prevails over emotional display.
If persuasion seems impossible, take what they hold dear.
Sometimes, a direct approach can be the most effective.
Bring them down to rock bottom. Make them lose the will to get back up, then extend your hand.

Make your offer kindly, but firmly.
It's important to make it seem like they have a choice.

Avoid questions. Don't give answers.
Remind them they have no control.

Give them what they want, then gradually exert your influence.
Shaking their foundations is highly effective.

Make sure they can't go back.
Ruin the place they came from, and destroy their original life.

pages.title: In The Mirror
pages.text: In The Mirror is an action-adventure game that explores a mysterious world.

pages.title: Basic Movement
pages.text: Control Cinderella with the joystick on the lower left or the WASD keys.

pages.title: Jump
pages.text: Press the Jump button on the lower right or the space bar to leap over terrains and obstacles of a certain height.

pages.title: Basic Attack
pages.text:
Press the Basic Attack button on the lower right or the left mouse button to launch basic attacks.
The Auto-Aim feature is available on mobile devices for targeting enemies.

pages.title: Others
pages.text:
Cinderella's skills can be unlocked during the game.
Complete main missions and defeat the hidden bosses to unlock them.

pages.title: Easy Mode
pages.text:
A feature that adjusts the difficult to make viewing the story easier.
When enabled, your character's HP will not decrease.
You can adjust the settings in Title or Option.

pages.title: Module Screen
pages.text: You can view or equip the modules you have obtained in the Modules screen.

pages.title: Module List
pages.text: In the Module list, you can view the features of each module and the amount of energy consumed when equipped.

pages.title: Module Energy
pages.text:
Module energy is consumed when the module is equipped.
The total amount of module energy can be upgraded in the Upgrade Shop.

pages.title: Collection Items Screen
pages.text:
You can view the details of the Collection Items you've collected on the Collection Items screen.
While playing In The Mirror, you can view the Memories and Keys that have been obtained or can be obtained.

pages.title: Memory
pages.text:
A collection item that can be obtained in In The Mirror.
Contains various information.

pages.title: Key
pages.text:
A collection item that can be obtained in In The Mirror.
Use it to open corresponding doors and move to the next area.

pages.title: Main Missions
pages.text:
Main missions that can be played in In The Mirror.
Reach progress targets to get rewards.

pages.title: Challenges
pages.text:
Challenges that can be completed in In The Mirror.
Complete challenges to get rewards.
Challenges are not affected by your game progress, and each challenge can only be completed once to get rewards.

pages.title: General Shop
pages.text:
In the Shop, you can purchase various data and modules that can enhance Cinderella's Glass Slippers.
Use the currency obtained In The Mirror to purchase various items.

pages.title: Upgrade Shop
pages.text:
Upgrade Shop is a place in In The Mirror where you can enhance Cinderella's skills.
Use the currency obtained from In The Mirror to upgrade her six different skills.

pages.title: Jump
pages.text: Press the Jump button on the lower right or the space bar to leap over terrains and obstacles of a certain height.

pages.title: Shortcuts
pages.text:
Use shortcuts to open the menu on PC.

■ ESC: Pause (Resume)
■ P: Progress Info
■ I: Modules
■ L: Collection Items
■ M: Map
■ O: Option
■ J: Missions

pages.title: Mini Map
pages.text:
The mini map can help you to track your exploration progress in the Glass World.
You can check out locations that you haven't explored yet or find the positions of save points and shops.

pages.title: New Game+
pages.text:
After reaching the end, you can start a new game with the data you have saved.
The difficulty of the new game will increase, but your map exploration progress and obtained items will be retained.
However, your main mission progress will be reset, and new main missions will begin for New Game+.
